bottleneck.summary: All-token lambda gain +.0606…+.1324 and Tc+.808 K accompanies path0/Gammaopt+. Geoopt BFGS failure has small final printed force2.75e-5; fine force .02614/stress .126 GPa are explicit. Ti2W is better source response but has negative path and is not hidden. Heavy Re/SOC may change small benefit.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 2.5968144075544575e-05 eV/Å, pressure 0.0 GPa; fine force 0.026138094008553832 eV/Å, pressure 0.05600000000000001 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Tc-to-Re role modification in Ti2X. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Resolve Ti/Re/Tc EPC modes and differential SOC/Coulomb sensitivity. Favorable: small coherent source gain remains; adverse: relevant correction reverses sign or unstable branch is required; ambiguous: no matched mode evidence.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
